frame: Opening on rain-slick flagstones before the burning city gate. Hero screen left in low defensive stance, one spear soldier screen right starts a thrust; both fully visible.
action: Start with an immediate spear thrust, not a still pose. Hero steps outside the spear, sword intercepts its shaft at a visible point with an orange spark. He advances one step and strikes the enemy's weapon guard, forcing him backward. Low tracking view then one cut to a side medium-wide shot. End as hero advances toward the gate, sword in his right hand. Exactly two foreground fighters.

frame: Same courtyard, closer to the stone stairs beside the gate. Hero center-left is running toward screen right, cape trailing left. Two distinct red-armored foes ahead: one with a short saber at right front, one with a round wooden shield one body length behind. Keep all hands and weapons separate.
action: Two opponents try to flank him. In a full-body side view the general catches the FIRST soldier's saber on his own sword, turns his hips, and shoves the weapon outward. Without changing grip he plants his left boot and delivers ONE right-leg kick against the SECOND soldier's shield, sending the shield bearer stumbling. He lands and turns toward the next threat. Two strong readable contacts with tiny impact frames and water splashes, not rapid random flailing. One motivated cut to low front 3/4 view; preserve spatial order.

frame: At the foot of the same city gate's broad stone steps, hero left with sword ready low, a red-armored spearman at right with a level spear. The stone wall and torn red banner from prior scenes remain visible, orange cinders in cool evening air.
action: A low spear sweep skims toward his legs. The general makes ONE compact grounded hop over the shaft, lands on the wet step with a splash, then immediately closes the distance and pins the spear down with his sword near the blade. He shoulder-checks the soldier off balance and moves up ONE step. Start in medium-wide profile, cut once to low-angle front as he lands, then pull slightly wider to show both bodies. Anime action timing: anticipation, contact, recoil. No flying, no spinning multiple times.

frame: Same gate courtyard beneath a damaged wooden canopy. A burning crossbeam overhead is visibly cracked, about to fall between the hero at left and one saber enemy at right. Hero looks upward alert with sword lowered right. Fire and ash behind, open safe landing area to his right.
action: The burning wooden crossbeam breaks and falls BEHIND the two fighters, creating a dramatic shower of stylized orange embers. In the foreground the soldier rushes. Hero makes one low sidestep, parries the saber outward, turns and performs one short controlled counter against the opponent's armor guard. No blade through flesh. The enemy recoils as the wood hits ground behind them; sparks and drawn debris fly only in background, leaving their hands and faces clear. Tracking side view into a low 3/4 angle; no long slow motion, no giant fireball hiding the action.

frame: Directly before the open city gate arch, orange light beyond. Hero screen left faces an imposing red-armored enemy captain screen right, each holding ONE straight sword in right hand. Both are grounded in ready stances, entire upper bodies, hands and knees visible. Same hero's black mask and cel-shaded face, not photoreal.
action: Tight, intense captain duel with only THREE readable exchanges: captain cuts diagonally down, hero catches and redirects the blade; captain reverses into a horizontal cut, hero ducks under it; hero steps inside and drives a compact upward parry that opens the captain's guard. One close shot of crossed steel and eyes for less than one second, then full bodies again so footwork remains clear. Clean orange sparks at actual contacts, short graphic white blade streaks, no laser swords. End with captain staggered backward and hero poised to finish.

frame: Continuation of the captain duel just inside the gate. Hero left in an advanced stance, captain right has an open guard and is leaning back. Both swords remain distinct and straight, same costumes. Behind them, courtyard and distant friendly silhouettes are becoming visible through thinning smoke.
action: The general makes ONE decisive wrist-led strike against the captain's sword guard, disarming him: enemy sword visibly leaves the enemy hand and falls to the ground at screen right. Hero keeps his own sword firmly in his right hand throughout. Captain stumbles back out of frame. Hero plants his boots, cape sweeps behind him, rain and embers settle. Cut from the clear full-body finishing move to a medium close-up of the same distinctly DRAWN anime eyes behind his black-silver mask. Last two seconds pull back to reveal the secured gate and distant friendly soldiers advancing behind him. Powerful composed ending, stern expression, no smile, no speech.
